theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_pinching
theorems.statement: ConicalApproximationTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ γ ε : ℝ, 0 < γ → γ < 1 → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → ∃ δP cs : ℝ, 0 < δP ∧ 0 < cs ∧ cs ≤ (1 - γ) / 16 ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δP → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall 0 ((1 + γ) / 2 * ρ), V.weight (closedBall y (cs * ρ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * (unitBallVolume n * (cs * ρ) ^ n))
